# pwd

Print the absolute working directory through MoonX.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/pwd

moonx cli/pwd -L
```

Default to the physical path unless POSIXLY_CORRECT is set. -L uses a valid logical PWD; otherwise it falls back to the runtime directory.

## Common options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->
<!-- Generated by tools/metadata from options.json. -->

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-L`, `--logical` | Use a valid logical PWD path. |
| `-P`, `--physical` | Resolve the physical directory path. |
| `--help` | Show help. |
| `--version` | Show the version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.

## Notes

Workspace builds use the MoonBit 2026-11-26 toolchain.
